$comment: Frontend side of the backend contract. The source of truth is the backend's Pydantic models, exported to backend/openapi.json. `source` is this app's pinned byte-for-byte copy of it (refresh with `npm run contract:sync`); when `upstream` exists, the contract tests require the two to be identical. Concepts map what the UI needs to the official schema names.

translationResponse.description: English draft for confirmation (UI type EnglishDraft). Text only, never audio.

speechRequest.description: Confirmed text to speak (POST /speak), sent only after the user confirms.

health.description: Backend liveness and provider configuration (connection status in the UI).

errorResponse.description: Shape of every backend error; its message is shown to the user.

recognizedSign.description: One recognized sign. Not served by the backend yet; recognition stays on the demo recognizer until ml/ provides it.
